<CLT=cltSYSTEM>From this point on, lines of <CLT=cltSTRONG>white noise<CLT=cltSYSTEM> will appear
to disrupt your reactions.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Your Truth Bullets will disappear if they touch these
lines, so think of them as <CLT=cltSTRONG>obstacles<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Please time your Truth Bullets just right so they
won't get interrupted by the white noise.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You can use the <CLT=cltSTRONG>silencer<CLT=cltSYSTEM> with <PAD=【○】>
to shoot down the white noise.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Because not only does that make it easier
to shoot the right weak spots...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>you will also get <CLT=cltSTRONG>additional time<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.
What a great deal!
